true_leverage.statement: Your true lever is private research that you convert into a shipped offer on a fixed date — not the research alone, and not the defense against peers.
true_leverage.why_not_other_candidates: The incremental income step is structurally ready: Direct Wealth ties with Rob Wealth as the second-heaviest force and sits on the year stem, so the capacity to carry money is there. But it stalls because Indirect Resource is the heaviest force in the chart and expands to fill whatever time you give it. The defense against peers is also real — Rob Wealth is tied with Direct Wealth — but defense only works when you have something shipped worth defending. The research is the engine, but the handover date is the steering wheel. Without the date, the research keeps running and the income step never completes. The lever is the handover decision, powered by the research.
true_leverage.evidence: Indirect Resource is the heaviest force in the chart, appearing on the month stem and repeating in three hidden branches. The Day Master is balanced, with metal and earth as favorable elements, so using the research returns energy rather than spending it. Direct Wealth ties with Rob Wealth as the second-heaviest force and sits on the year stem — the income step can carry load, but it needs a shipped offer to move.

use_cases.scene: You have a research thread that has been almost ready for weeks. You keep refining it because the next iteration feels safer than the handover.
use_cases.action: Pick the one piece that has been almost ready the longest. Set a handover date within ten days. On that date, send it even if it feels unfinished. Write down the approval or title you were waiting for next to the date you actually sent it. This completes the income step and breaks the permission rule.
use_cases.how_it_shows: You will notice the urge to add one more layer before sending. The date is external and fixed, so the research cannot expand to fill the time. The written record of what you were waiting for shows you the gap between the permission you imagined and the handover you actually completed.
use_cases.evidence: Indirect Resource is the heaviest force and expands to fill whatever time you give it. Direct Wealth is tied with Rob Wealth as the second-heaviest force and sits on the year stem, so the income step is ready to carry load once a shipped offer exists.

use_cases.scene: A peer starts offering something you built. Your first instinct is to correct them in a meeting or defend your ground verbally.
use_cases.action: Within the week, add one layer they have not copied and ship it. Make the layer small enough to finish in a day. Note the date it left your desk. This turns the defense step into a conversion step and keeps the loop moving forward.
use_cases.how_it_shows: You will feel the pull to argue about ownership. The action redirects that energy into a shipped layer. The date on the desk becomes the evidence that defense converted into income rather than staying a verbal dispute.
use_cases.evidence: Rob Wealth ties with Direct Wealth as the second-heaviest force, so peer competition is a structural step, not a distraction. The defense only works when there is ground worth defending — a shipped offer — and the conversion step is what keeps the loop advancing.

use_cases.scene: Your calendar is broken into meetings and your research time is fragmented. You feel busy but nothing leaves your desk.
use_cases.action: For two weeks, keep a one-line ledger each day: what you researched, what left your desk, and what you defended. At the end of each week, compare the three lines. If research and defense are full but the desk line is empty, prune the research thread that is only interesting and convert the one that has a buyer.
use_cases.how_it_shows: The ledger makes the loop visible. You will see whether the research is feeding the income step or just running in place. The weekly comparison shows which thread has a buyer and which one is only interesting.
use_cases.evidence: Indirect Resource is the heaviest force, so research will expand unless a date is set externally. Metal and earth are favorable elements, and the balanced Day Master means research feeds your core — but only if the research reaches a buyer.

next_90_days.one_thing: Set a fixed handover date at the start of every piece of research you begin, and ship on that date regardless of whether it feels finished.
next_90_days.completion_signal: You have a written log of at least three shipped pieces, each with a start date and a handover date, and the gap between the two is ten days or less. The log also records what you were waiting for before sending — approval, title, or permission — next to the date you actually sent it.
next_90_days.why_this_works: Direct Wealth is tied with Rob Wealth as the second-heaviest force and sits on the year stem, so the income step is structurally ready to carry load. The bottleneck is the handover decision. Indirect Resource is the heaviest force and will expand to fill whatever time you give it unless a date is set externally. A fixed date converts research energy into a shipped offer, which is the only step that closes the loop.
next_90_days.evidence: Indirect Resource is the heaviest force in the chart, appearing on the month stem and repeating in three hidden branches. Direct Wealth ties with Rob Wealth as the second-heaviest force and sits on the year stem. The Day Master is balanced, with metal and earth as favorable elements, so using the research returns energy rather than spending it.

falsification_signals.signal: You set handover dates and ship on them for three months, but the shipped offers do not reach a buyer — they sit in a drawer or a shared folder with no response.
falsification_signals.what_it_means: The bottleneck is not the handover decision but the path from finding to buyer. The environment check about direct contact with the person who uses your work was wrong for your situation. The analysis assumed the income step was ready to carry load once a shipped offer existed. If shipped offers consistently fail to reach a buyer, the lever is not the handover date — it is the distribution path, and this analysis should be thrown out and re-examined.
falsification_signals.evidence: Direct Wealth ties with Rob Wealth as the second-heaviest force and sits on the year stem. The analysis assumed the income step was structurally ready. If shipped offers do not reach a buyer, that assumption is falsified.

falsification_signals.signal: You ship on fixed dates for three months, and your private research time collapses — you feel drained rather than recharged, and the research threads you prune are the ones that were feeding you.
falsification_signals.what_it_means: The analysis assumed that metal and earth are favorable elements and that the balanced Day Master means research returns energy rather than spending it. If shipping on fixed dates consistently drains you and the research that feeds you gets pruned in favor of shipping, then the lever is misidentified. The research is not the engine that pays you back — it is a cost. This analysis should be thrown out and the favorable elements re-examined.
falsification_signals.evidence: The Day Master is balanced, with metal and earth as favorable elements. The analysis assumed research returns energy rather than spending it. If shipping on fixed dates drains you and prunes the research that feeds you, that assumption is falsified.
